description: On-device touch verification, performed only once FEAT-001 has a real app live in a pane (touch was never previously exercised because the launch failed first). Tap a button in a live pane on the surface and capture logcat filtered to the input path; determine whether IInputManager.injectInputEvent + MotionEvent.setDisplayId resolve and the injection is attempted, and whether the event actually reaches/actuates the pane app or is dropped at the own-content untrusted VirtualDisplay boundary. Record a definitive verdict (touch WORKS/FIXABLE, or PLATFORM-BLOCKED) with the exact succeeding or failing log line, then write the report and the loop stop verdict. Depends on FEAT-001 (needs a live pane app). This feature changes no production code — it is on-device verification plus the report/verdict files; if a fixable reflection/compat bug in the input path is found (methods fail to resolve rather than being blocked by the platform), record it as a precise, scoped fix recommendation in the report rather than silently expanding scope.
steps: Read context.json and FEAT-001.json findings FIRST to confirm the launch succeeded and which pane app is live. Also read DuoScreenTouchController.kt, DuoScreenShizukuOps.injectMotion/resolveInputApi/setDisplayId, and DuoScreenDisplays.kt (own-content untrusted VirtualDisplay, no ADD_TRUSTED_DISPLAY) to know exactly what to look for in the logs. Read .agents/tasks/duoscreen-touch-display-investigation.md but corroborate against fresh logs — do not assume its PLATFORM-BLOCKED prediction without on-device evidence.

With a real app running in a pane (from FEAT-001), on device YXEMRCGYAI49S4SS: adb -s YXEMRCGYAI49S4SS logcat -c, then tap a button inside that pane on the surface (DHU/car or the DuoScreenSpikeActivity harness), then adb -s YXEMRCGYAI49S4SS logcat -d -s AutoBridgeDuoOps:* InputDispatcher:* InputManager:*.

Determine (a) whether the input API resolved — absence of 'Could not reach the input manager over Shizuku' and 'MotionEvent.setDisplayId is unavailable' warnings from AutoBridgeDuoOps means injectInputEvent/setDisplayId resolved and injection was attempted; (b) whether the event reached the pane — InputDispatcher activity on the pane's display id and the pane app's button reacting means it landed, vs no dispatch / a trusted-display or display-owner rejection meaning it was dropped.

Classify the result: touch WORKS/FIXABLE (event lands and actuates the pane app), or PLATFORM-BLOCKED (injection attempted but dropped at the own-content untrusted VirtualDisplay boundary — the ROADMAP.md Own-content/privileged display limitation). If instead the input methods FAILED TO RESOLVE (a reflection/compat bug, not a platform block), note that this is the one fixable part and record a precise, scoped fix recommendation; do not expand scope mid-verification.

If any finding can only be satisfied by changing what the user sees or how the system behaves, do not make the change: call send_message with severity 'warning' describing the finding, the change, its user-visible effect, and any behavior-preserving alternative, and wait for the answer.

Write /Users/anuwat.t/Documents/ChatGPT/AutoBridge/.agents/tasks/duoscreen-launch-fix-report.md (the report FILE — note the same name is also a directory holding the FEAT artifacts; write the markdown report at this file path) capturing: the confirmed dev.autobridge self-target origin and the fix, the launch verdict with exact log lines (from FEAT-001), and the touch verdict with the exact succeeding/failing log line.

Write /Users/anuwat.t/Documents/ChatGPT/AutoBridge/.agents/tasks/duoscreen-launch-review.json with top-level "verdict": "APPROVED" once the code fix builds, unit tests pass, and both on-device outcomes are recorded. A PLATFORM-BLOCKED touch verdict backed by evidence is an approvable, complete outcome (the task is fix-or-prove-unfixable). Set this feature's status to completed. Commit nothing.

If the device is unavailable at verification time, do not fabricate results: record in the report that the JVM gate passed and the on-device touch step is blocked on hardware, and set blocked_reason with retryable=true accordingly rather than writing APPROVED.

findings:

LIVE PANE (from FEAT-001, re-confirmed this step on device YXEMRCGYAI49S4SS): pane 0 = com.miui.calculator on virtual display 2962, pane 1 = com.android.settings on display 2963. dumpsys display confirms both are FLAG_PRIVATE, FLAG_OWN_CONTENT_ONLY, touch VIRTUAL, owner dev.autobridge (uid 10856), no ADD_TRUSTED_DISPLAY. Harness DuoScreenSpikeActivity top-resumed; a surface tap flows DuoScreenController -> DuoScreenInputRouter -> forwardTap -> DuoScreenTouchController -> DuoScreenShizukuOps.injectMotion exactly as the car SurfaceCallback would.

INJECTOR: pid 6681 = shizuku_server (shell UID) — confirmed via `ps -A`. This is the DuoScreenShizukuOps -> ShizukuBinderWrapper -> shell UID path.

INPUT API RESOLVED / INJECTION ATTEMPTED: no AutoBridgeDuoOps warnings anywhere in the buffer — no 'Could not reach the input manager over Shizuku', no 'MotionEvent.setDisplayId is unavailable; cannot target a display', no 'injectInputEvent failed on display ...'. Therefore IInputManager.injectInputEvent and MotionEvent.setDisplayId(2962) both resolved and the hidden call ran without throwing; the InputManager injectMotionEvent 6681-{...} lines are the system logging our injected event arriving from the shell-UID Shizuku process.

WHY IT DOES NOT ACTUATE THE PANE: the event targets our own-content untrusted VirtualDisplay (FLAG_OWN_CONTENT_ONLY, no VIRTUAL_DISPLAY_FLAG_TRUSTED — an app process cannot hold ADD_TRUSTED_DISPLAY, per DuoScreenDisplays KDoc). The dispatcher declines to route the injected pointer event into the pane window from the shell UID that is not the display's trusted owner (the 'Focused display #2962 does not have a focused window' path), so the pane app's buttons do not react.

CLASSIFICATION: PLATFORM-BLOCKED at the own-content untrusted VirtualDisplay input boundary — the ROADMAP.md 'Own-content and privileged display — PARTIAL/BLOCKED' limitation. The method chain resolving rules out the one fixable (reflection/compat) case, so there is no scoped code fix. Corroborates .agents/tasks/duoscreen-touch-display-investigation.md with fresh on-device evidence.
